mapper.sql: id::text as "fileId", scene_id::text as "sceneId", relative_path as "relativePath", expected_bytes as bytes, expected_sha256 as sha256, status, failure_reason as "failureReason", attempts
mapper.select: select from ar_scene_file where scene_id = cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) order by relative_path, id
select from ar_scene_file where scene_id = cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) and id = cast(#{fileId} as uuid)
mapper.update: update ar_scene_file set status = 'UPLOADING', failure_reason = null, verified_bytes = null, verified_sha256 = null, attempts = attempts + 1, last_actor_id = #{actor}, last_actor_name = #{actorName}, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{fileId} as uuid)
mapper.select: select scene_id::text as "sceneId", last_actor_id as "actorId", last_actor_name as "actorName" from ar_scene_file where id = cast(#{fileId} as uuid)
mapper.update: update ar_scene_file set status = #{status}, verified_bytes = case when #{available} then expected_bytes else null end, verified_sha256 = case when #{available} then expected_sha256 else null end, failure_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{fileId} as uuid)
mapper.select: select id::text from ar_scene_file where scene_id = cast(#{sceneId} as uuid) order by id
mapper.delete: delete from ar_scene_file where scene_id = cast(#{sceneId} as uuid)
mapper.select: select from ar_scene_file f where f.id > cast(#{cursor} as uuid) and f.status in ('PENDING', 'UPLOADING', 'FAILED') and not exists(select 1 from ar_scene_deletion d where d.scene_id = f.scene_id and d.completed_at is null) and not exists(select 1 from ar_scene s where s.id = f.scene_id and s.deleted_at is not null) order by f.id limit 100
